verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, on the same docs site as Stripe Tax, so an agent can connect officially. The evidence is a single probe line and never shows which tools the server exposes or whether Tax calculations, transactions or registrations are among them. Missing for 10: evidence of Tax-specific MCP tools, setup/auth documentation details, hands-on or community corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
